The variable B is stated as the magnetic flux density (magnitude of applied magnetic field). KB record pq_magnetic_flux_density is the canonical magnetic-flux-density entry (si_dimension M T^-2 I^-1) and explicitly notes this is the quantity with SI unit tesla commonly denoted B in MHD.
